snippet.title: Forza Killer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4534200/Incremental_Retro_Racing/
Free Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/45...

Earn more and more stars by driving faster and faster in Incremental Retro Racing. Accumulate and unlock 70+ vehicles, upgrades, track generation options, and more. Includes unlimited tracks and customizable CRT filter for that old school retro feel.

Music by jaysmusic from Pixabay, remixed by Baardmoeder.
